test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The__ lenient __ways of the manager prompted substandard work from his subordinates.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. easygoing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lenient"** means permissive, merciful, or tolerant. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher was lenient with her students and allowed them extra time to complete their assignments.
 
 
 
• **"Easygoing"** refers to a relaxed and tolerant attitude, not strict or demanding. (आसान)
 
 
• **Example: **He has an easygoing nature, which makes him a favorite among his friends.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'lenient' **is **'easygoing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. easygoing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignorant** (अज्ञानी): Lacking knowledge, awareness, or information.
 
 
• **Example:** He remained ignorant of the issues affecting his community.
 
 
 
• **Irritating** (परेशान करने वाला): Causing annoyance or discomfort.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant noise from the construction site was very irritating.
 
 
 
• **Insane** (पागल): In a state of mind that prevents normal perception, behavior, or social interaction; seriously mentally ill.
 
 
• **Example:** The idea seemed insane, but it worked perfectly in the end.
